Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.report

Class JsonReportGenerator

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.report.AbstractReportGenerator<com.google.gson.JsonObject>
comp3607.group10.telemetry.report.JsonReportGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReportGenerator
public class JsonReportGenerator extends AbstractReportGenerator<com.google.gson.JsonObject>
A concrete class of the Template Method pattern that writes the session as a JSON file with Gson: a schema version, the metadata block and the event log in time order.
Author:
Reinaldo Singh
